text:
emma: New product launch blog draft ready: https://docs.google.com/redwood/launch-draft-4. Need quick legal + ops check — target publish Thu 09:00 PT.

josh: skimmed. can we avoid absolute language around latency? data wants 'as measured in internal benchmarks' phrasing.

priya: data here: consolidated run on dedicated pool (A100-80GB) -> median 58 ms, 95th per-token 395 ms, throughput ~8.3k tok/s. I'll drop raw CSV in the doc.

emma: thanks. legal (tom) can you ok the bench sentence?

tom: prefer: "As measured in our internal benchmarks, the 95th percentile per-token latency was 395 ms (dedicated A100-80GB pool; 64-token average). Test conditions may differ from production traffic." Approve if that's used verbatim.

josh: good. Growth needs UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=dedicated_q2. Also capture hidden field `lead_channel=blog`.

emma: noted. Ops — form mapping for demos? We want enterprise routing for on-prem or seat_count>=5. mid-market 2-4, self-serve 0-1.

priya: adding that rule in the doc and linking run logs: https://internal.redwood/bench/2026-04-20-dedicated.csv

tom: legal sign-off conditional on adding the raw link + caveat line.

emma: done. design to lock hero once legal confirms.

publishbot: Publish hold set. Will block until legal sign-off and HubSpot mapping confirmed.

emma: thanks team — i'll flip the hold when Kate confirms mapping tomorrow AM. :raised_hands:
